Vulnerability.Name: FortiOS Remote Code Execution
Vulnerability.Description: A use-after-free vulnerability in FortiOS allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
Vulnerability.Remediation: Update FortiOS to version 7.4.3 or later.

Vulnerability.Name: SQL Injection in Login Form
Vulnerability.Description: The login endpoint does not sanitize user input, allowing SQL injection attacks.
Vulnerability.Remediation: Use parameterized queries and input validation.

Vulnerability.Name: Outdated TLS Version
Vulnerability.Description: Server accepts TLS 1.0 connections which are considered insecure.
Vulnerability.Remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1. Enable TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only.
